received_works.body:
Hello! It is nice to meet you. 
I admire how diverse you are able to draw different characters. It is so cool.
I was wondering if you could help me revamp a younger design for one of my characters. 
For age, I am thinking around 18-20.

The character's name is "Rei".
He is a traveler from the desertlands. He eventually grows up to become the ruler of the lands after becoming a hero. (Fashion for civilians in the desertlands leans towards Middle Eastern fashion ). 
He is descended from a lightning bird. (I hope adding the lightning bird reference may help give some ideas. https://www.deviantart.com/stash/0jr5rwj4lkn )

His main outfit for this age I have is -- https://www.deviantart.com/stash/016jwr2p8flt

Main outfit when he is older-- https://www.deviantart.com/stash/01jdniq8hg39

His role in my story is to be the rival of this character. In both combat and love, haha.  https://www.deviantart.com/stash/01bjt60o3evq
(They are from different cultures.)

Personality: Outgoing, heroic personality. 

Feel free to take creative liberties with him. If you think adding color to his hair could fit that is totally fine too. Or if you would like to change up his hairstyle to contrast with his rival that's totally fine too.  
I hope I gave enough information to work from.

Thanks for the consideration!

Thanks for your time!
I would like to send you the contents of my request for a standing picture!


This time, I would like to request a 15th century Italian assassin!
I would be happy if he has some resemblance to someone I commissioned from Noshi-san a long time ago, since he is an ancestor of the one I commissioned from him! He should be of the same height and slim build! I would like her to be dressed in a glamorous costume and to be able to hold a cane, as she is ostensibly an aristocrat! She is in her thirties!


↓Here is the previous request
Gender Male
Age 70's
Personality Gentleman
Height & Weight 189cm70kg

Appearance I would like a cute English gentleman with a hat and curls in his beard and a cane!
He should be slender and have some wrinkles appropriate for his age.

Hello again! I’d like another character design please!

Name: Soren Finlay Alistair

Age: 20s

Height: 1.82M

Hair: Short and well kept, sometimes is a bit messy when he’s rather busy in current affairs of the kingdom.

Appearance: A handsome, tall young man clad in red, prince-like clothing. Soren has short, curved demon horns from his heritage of being born to a human and demon parents. His skintone is slightly fair, but a light tan. 

Personality: Strong-willed, patient, calm and the ideal king. Despite his stoic appearance, he’s not afraid to show emotion.

Soren was born an illegitimate heir to the throne, born from his father having an affair with a lowborn demoness. Despite his appearance, the kingdom had no current heirs to the throne and chose him to become the next prince and future king.

Soren knew his heritage would be of a point of conflict, and decided that he’ll make a future that everyone is equal and to bring peace to his lands.

Thank you for all your help!
What we would like to request this time is a Japanese police officer who is a little bit sloppy!

He should be average height of about 175, and his body should be well rounded! He should be dressed in uniform (details can be different)!

Hair style should be short black hair, no other details are specified!


We look forward to working with you!

お世話になっております🌸
今回はのしさんに庭師の自探索者を描いていただきたいな〜！と思いリクエストさせて頂きました！

立ち絵ではなく、普段X(旧Twitter)に投稿されているゆるかわな落書きっぽいと嬉しいです。
シーン、セリフの有無、キャラの解釈などはまるっとおまかせ致します。

もし可能でしたら、同卓の皆さんからも使用許可を頂いてますので一緒に描いていただけると嬉しいです…！

資料は二条の分だけ添付させて頂いてます。
ご検討のほどよろしくお願い致します🍋

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CDDKq3y6XTvuDyAinAKRmCGdhcS3ncsK/view?usp=sharing

Thank you for all your help: ！！！！

I would like to ask you to draw stills of four members of my team for a scenario called "B'ASH"!
There is one member who is not in uniform, so I would appreciate it if you could draw only him in uniform. ......！！！！


I will only give a brief introduction of each character so that you can get an idea of what you are looking for when drawing the stills!



HO1/ Kei Touta, male, 195 cm, SIZ17, 34 years old (the one with the hat)
Everyone, as always. I'm counting on you."
"That's good, isn't it? I like that kind of thing.

He is a leader who is kind to everyone and sometimes harsh to his friends. He often says, "If you are going to die, you can't save anyone," and he lectures them on how they should value their lives. If you are going to die, make sure you come back alive. These are contradictory words, but it is because he trusts his members.



HO2: Ootsuki KAGETORA (the one with the odd eyes wearing a hairpin)
Height: 169 cm Gender: Male Age: 25 years old
What are you looking at? Ah? ...... from the same workplace? （Who's that?"
Don't mistake recklessness for courage. If you don't make it back alive, stay away from the fire!
I'll get you out of there. If I don't do it, who will beat the flames?

Eat vegetables.
He never remembers people's names.
He's a tsundere yankee.
. foolhardy, stubborn, and stupid.
(Aside) Whenever I jump into the fire or send off my friends during a mission, I always say "I'm off" or "Go", and when I welcome them, I say "Welcome back" - a regular habit on every mission. This is a regular custom for every mission of our HO2.



HO3 Takashi Morokuma (That's me)
Male 180cm, 25 years old

Me/Anta Position (call me by HO)

"That's nice... You're super COOL!
Success rate? If it was a normal firefighter.
With you guys, it would be 100%.

He is frivolous, aloof, and often jokes around. The firefighters are not only the most experienced, but they are also the most experienced.
He takes a step back from the front line and calmly analyzes the situation. Human life comes before anything else.



HO4 Waka Gaku (the one in combat pose)

The type who is strict with others and more strict with herself.
Basically, she is a hasty talker, but she greets people well. She doesn't joke around much, but takes people's jokes seriously.
He eats three meals a day, exercises, sleeps well, and spends more time training himself than using his smartphone.
I respect people who are good at something and can do things that I can't do.

https://dochub.com/%E3%81%8A%E3%81%A8%E3%81%AA%E3%81%97/Xv7zYW5Rn87L97ZV2A9egx/%E3%83%9B%E3%83%86%E3%83%AB%E3%82%A2%E3%83%B3%E3%83%87%E3%83%AB%E3%82%BB%E3%83%B3%EF%BC%92-png

お世話になっております、ろくろうです。ノシさんのスマートでかっこいい絵柄でまた見たい……！というキャラクターがおりまして創作企画の二人組（よその子の親御さんには許可をいただいています！）リクエストさせていただいております！

二人とも元々は人間ですが死後地獄へと堕ち、現在は悪魔になって地獄で生活しています。二人は恋愛関係にありますが情熱的というよりは穏やかな繋がりで、恋人というよりは伴侶という形容が近いです。

Aは真面目で責任感が強い性格です。生前は落語家で、現在も熱心に落語を続けています。自分の大切な人達を守る為に強くなろうと鍛錬を重ねている最中です。
Bは穏やかな性格で物腰柔らかです。生前は肉弾戦銃撃戦共に優秀な傭兵で、現在は親しい人達に戦い方を教えています。大切な人達の為なら汚れ仕事も厭いません。

ABともに資料01の服装で、日常というよりは戦闘！かっこいい！といった感じの雰囲気が見れれば嬉しいです！
ポーズや構図などはノシさんにお任せいたします。以下URLに資料を添付しております。何卒よろしくお願いいたします。

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1YVfdRNfl0OQH38dodYvgA2BU3mkUchpU?usp=sharing

Hello! I apologize for bugging you, but I'd like to request an illustration as a gift for my friend who does so much for me. His character name is SM5N, like Samson. He is an AI with a human body that controls a space ship. SM5N can be a bit smug at times, but he is well-meaning with a big heart. He has white hair and wears a visor over his eyes that has an audio visualizer when he speaks. SM5N normally sits in a large captain's chair, because he controls a large space ship. I would love for you to please draw him as you see fit and include any expressions you might think of! 

https://imgur.com/a/75ccnbc

Thank you for all your help!
I enjoy playing TRPG with the standing pictures drawn by Noshi-san: ！！！！

This time, I would like to ask you to draw a standing picture for a scenario called "B'ASH" (scenario outline URL.https://booth.pm/ja/items/3456172)! HO will be in charge of the team BRAIN in 3!


Gender Male
Age Early 20's
Hair Color/Hair Style Black hair / tied back in a ponytail
Height/Weight 182cm/80kg

Characteristics: Sunglasses, gnarled teeth (would be nice if they were emphasized) Physique is good for a firefighter. As for his mood, he is the type who makes exaggerated gestures and jokes around when explaining a situation. But when serious, he is crisp! I would be happy to have a tablet as a small accessory!

He wears sunglasses basically, and as a difference, only one lens of his sunglasses is broken, but he doesn't break his smile! I would be happy to have a difference like this: ！！！！


B'ASH" has a specific uniform! I'm sorry for the inconvenience, but I would appreciate it if you could refer to the above scenario outline URL for the uniform material. We apologize for any trouble this may cause.



Thank you in advance!

Hello again, thank you for your continued support! I'd like to request another character design!

Name: Jackson 'Bullfrog' Ramos

Age: Mid 40s

Height: 183 cm

Hair: Dark brown, very well taken care of dreadlocks. Along with well kept mustache and chin hair.

Appearance: A tall, muscular dark skinned male with gentle brown eyes. Wears tank tops and fishing overalls, along with tall boots. He sometimes wears a fishing hat and jacket on colder days. Has a large fishing rod that also doubles as a polearm, with a spear at the end.

Jackson is an easygoing fisherman/martial artist, with a very easy going and calm demeanor. Raised by frogmen, Jackson is a very powerful warrior, trained in the way of aquatic arts.

Thank you very much for your continued support!
I would like to request two patterns of standing pictures of the same person!

Gender Male
Age 60's
Height 180~185cm

He is a veteran actor, and his acting ability is second to none.
He is the type of person who can be soft to everyone, despite his position of superiority in the industry!
He will be playing the role of a "curator" on stage.

This time, we would like to ask for the actor's plain clothes Ver and the costume he wears during the performance (suit, gloves and monocle would be preferable) Ver! This request was made because I want to feel the gap between the actor's normal routine and the performance as much as possible!

Also, I would like to have one of the facial expressions with the face painted completely black so that only a part of the face (only the eyes, only one eye, only the mouth with a grin) can be seen. It's the kind of expression a mastermind would do...!


Sorry for the many requests! Thank you very much for your consideration.

Dear Mr. Noshi!
I would like to request a Karakira costume diff for Aragami!
I'd appreciate it if you could give me a normal and smiling expression.
I'll leave it to you to decide about the sun visor, etc!

Happy New Year! I hope to spend this year with Noshi's wonderful standing pictures!

Now to the main topic, this time I would like to ask you to draw a monk who is a friend of the punk rock monk I requested before! Although he is a serious priest now, when he talks with Punk Rock Monk, he is the kind of person who goes back to his old, wild days! He should be tall and chubby! I am also a fan of rock music, so I would be happy if you could include that element in the picture as well!

We are talking about going on a trip to America together, so please wear casual clothes!
As for the pose, I'd be happy if it's in a fun way alongside the standing picture of Punk Rock Monk (plain clothes ver.) that I have requested before. ...... If it's too difficult, that's totally fine!

Thank you very much for your consideration! Have a great year!

Hello again! I enjoyed the last character sheet you made me, and I'd like another one!

Name: Gustavo Magnolia-Night

Gender- Male

Hair: Dark brown graying hair arranged in a quiff, well kept like his beard. His hair is sometimes hidden underneath his hat.

Appearance: A tall, rotund man (190cm) with large cat ears (No human ears, he comes from a beastman race that has animal-like traits) and a short cat tail. Amber eyes, and a large belly. Tanned skin. 

Clothing: Western/cowboy clothing, along with a large duster coat. He wears a large cowboy hat that's made specifically to fit his ears. a hostler on his hip that holds a rather large revolver.

Personality: Strong-willed and hardworking, very generous, but very easy to anger. 

Gustavo is a leader of a desert land of beastmen, who ended up in a new home after being displaced by war. Leading a mining company, Gustavo helped his fellow beastmen settle in, and raised a daughter named Charlotte. Despite his larger size, he's incredibly skilled with a pistol.

I'd like him to have some similar traits to his daughter, with the differences being tail size and his much larger ears. Here's his daughter for reference: https://imgur.com/a/charlotte-magnolia-night-F1qPUKO

Hello! I'd like to request an illustration of my OC Kato.

He is a 25 year old with an anxious and stiff personality who struggles with hallucinations because of a former trauma. However, he eventually becomes an investigator with the intent of searching for a lost loved one. In this universe, there are supernatural anomalies that he investigates with a work partner.

I'd like him to be drawn in a professional suit and coat similar to a private investigator or a detective, here is a link to a folder with inspiration images. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1B7WtKuCU7Y8RcfzrPlJ1mpw6IRCqhgZ9?usp=drive_link
His hair is usually somewhat messy or can be in a small ponytail.
He wears a choker or bandages around his neck.
His normal clothing style is dark/street style.
He is tall (180 cm.)

I hope the level of description is okay! Thank you for considering!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ZMYDP87m63_W5ql5Fg9cfuv09M6pGBjq?usp=drive_link

Thank you for your continued support!
What I would like to request this time is "a brilliant sculptor who is jealous of a genius"!

He is male, late 160s tall (a little smaller than average).
He has dark circles in his eyes and looks unhealthy.
Hair color should be black and his clothes should be work clothes!
I would be happy if the work clothes are not so much well-dressed as if the person is not careful about his appearance!

If the above is too difficult, you may alter the image to your own!
Thank you very much for your consideration.

He works for a demon hunting government organization that specializes the capture or neutralization of harmful demonic and magical beings.
A male in his mid 20's, crimson red eyes, blond hair, tan skin, 186cm in height with a muscular build. Wears a black dress shirt and pants with a red tie. When he is in combat he wears a combat body suit. He smokes special cigarettes that suppress the demonic essence/urges in his blood.
 Despite his serious looking demeanor, he cares about saving people and helping comrades.

Good evening! Thank you for your continued support!

The standing picture I would like to commission this time is of a "hero"! As a result of his continuous physical training to defeat the Demon King, he has become muscular and strong, and with his excess power he usually destroys the village's farming tools and other things! Wahaha! He is the kind of person who laughs with gusto!

If possible, I would like him to pose with his arms crossed and his chest out! I would be happy if he has large pectoral muscles!

As for the clothes, the setting is like an otherworldly world, so as long as it fits the atmosphere, you can wear armor or medieval-style clothes, whatever you like!


That's about it! I would be happy if you could draw the details according to your own image!
Thank you very much for your consideration~!

Good evening. Thank you for your continued support!

I would like to request an explorer based on the Chinese yokai "Baku" (a nightmare-eating yokai with the face of an elephant and the body of a tiger). He is a tall, slender man, born in China.

The normal difference is that I would like him to be lying down and wearing an eye mask in the way he sleeps, like a father relaxing at home on a holiday! You can hide his eyes completely! Although he has the blood of a demon, he is basically in human form, so the normal diff is of him as he would be in human form!

For the battle diff, I'd like to give the figure a more disastrous yokai look, so I'd appreciate it if you could add some of the characteristics of a "baku" on top of the human body! I'd like to leave the posing up to you!

Please dress the figure in kimono! I would be happy if the color is based on brown!


Other details are up to you!
Thank you for your consideration!

Thank you for your continued support!

She is a former slave, muscular from her past as a manual laborer, and has a brown skin tone. He has a tattoo of an octopus tentacle on his upper body as proof of his slavery. I would like him to have shredded chains fitted on both arms!

I would like her to be dressed in a casual outfit, and I would be happy if she wears sandals!

I would appreciate it if you could draw the other details as you like!
Thank you very much for your consideration.

のしさん、はじめまして！

I love your portfolio of standing images, so I was hoping to make a request to ask for your help. My character is a guitarist in a visual kei band. I'd like to request a standing image of him in his casual appearance and stage appearance. I've got them both designed, but when you put them side-by-side, I think it's difficult to tell that it's the same character, so I'd be happy if you could draw a single sheet with both versions!

In his casual appearance, he has scruffy dark brown hair and a lot of ear piercings. He also has various facial piercings - eyebrow piercing, nose bridge piercing, snake bite piercings. He shaves his eyebrows to suit the stage persona, so you can draw him with or without eyebrows. He has sharp shark-like teeth. His fashion style is grunge, and he usually wears something like cargo pants and a ragged hoodie. It's OK to use the same outfit with a green jacket from the reference material.

His stage costume is apocalyptic and cybergoth inspired. His "hair" is made of tubular crin and other synthetic materials. He wears a mask, respirator, or other facial coverings. There are different iterations of the costume in the reference material, so if you want to change any elements of the costume, that's OK! Hopefully the theme and style is easy to understand. 

Thank you for your consideration! If the amount is not enough, please send an appeal.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JOPlqIMfSuHNWT-MMz3iSfj_KOIxOGn1?usp=sharing

I would like her to wear a white, black, or monochromatic military uniform.

I would like to leave the composition and other details up to you!
Thank you very much for your consideration!

Thank you very much for your help, my name is 696. I have received the "highest" rating for my previous request to Noshi, and I would like to see two PCs from Shinobigami (one of them is not my character, but I have permission!) I would like to see them in your drawings!

They are two people who fought for the survival of the human race. One is a shinobi who ostensibly lives as a monk and had disciples, but they have passed away. On the other hand, he is a being who appeared to destroy mankind as a concept of disease, bringing death to the aforementioned disciples. Although they have turned against each other, there is no hatred or aversion between them.

Pose, composition, clothing, etc. are left up to Noshi. Please refer to the following URL for the material. (No scenario spoilers!)

Hello Mr. Noshi,

I really like your drawing style, so I would like to request character illustrations for my two OCs!

❖ Dungeon Lord

Name: YAN

Appearance: 28 years old, 190 cm tall, long silver hair down to the waist, golden eyes, toned muscles, robust build, cool beauty, fair skin.

Outfit: A pure white robe resembling ancient Egyptian clothing, loose pants instead of a skirt, showing abs, barefoot, a golden necklace signifying status hanging on the chest, black wrist guards, a white cape draped over the shoulders.

Personality: Cool, aloof, wise.

Background: Inhabitant of the underground, king of the dungeon, a superhuman who can manifest magic into ravens to do his bidding, often surrounded by ravens.

Reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ffVYP2WHRGaA6jKFHSkut7a3HrwXOOuX?usp=sharing

❖ Assassin

Name: CHEN

Appearance: 24 years old, 170 cm tall, short black hair, dark gray eyes, slim and fit build.

Outfit: Sleeveless high-neck black tight-fitting top, black work pants, belt, leather high boots, a windproof cloak, holster on the pants leg, a sniper rifle slung over the shoulder.

Personality: Depressed, repressed, tenacious, tsundere, easily angered.

Background: A land dweller employed as a bodyguard for wealthy families, proficient with all kinds of firearms, a gun-specialized assassin.

Reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MSegaz7-QXyC7RPbHxZ4ZH8ag5uso8cW

❖ Relationship: The underground inhabitants and the land dwellers are enemies. The dungeon needs the blood of the land dwellers to cure a plague, so YAN leads people to capture land dwellers, and CHEN must stop the dungeon's killing actions.

❖ Feel free to use your creativity for the composition. If the amount is insufficient, a new request can be submitted. I hope you will consider it! Thank you!
